lines.beaver: 세미나 준비 상황 같이 점검해 볼까요?
lines.beaver_en: Shall we check how the seminar prep is going?
lines.beaver_roman: semina junbi sanghwang gachi jeomgeomhae bolkkayo?
lines.en: Sure. Let's look at the documents first.

lines.learner: 네, 거의 다 됐다 싶어요. 오늘 끝낼게요.
lines.en: I think it's almost done. I'll finish it today.
lines.roman: ne, geoui da dwaetda sipeoyo. oneul kkeunnaelgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Did you send out the notice?
lines.learner: 어제 공지 메일에 안내 파일을 첨부해서 보냈어요.
lines.en: Yesterday I sent the notice email with the info file attached.
lines.roman: eoje gongji meire annae paireul cheombuhaeseo bonaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: About how many attendees are there?
lines.learner: 서른 명이 넘어서 좀 많다 싶었어요.
lines.en: Over thirty, so I thought it was a bit many.
lines.roman: seoreun myeongi neomeoseo jom manta sipeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then we might be a little short on chairs.
lines.en: Yes, I think we should borrow more chairs.

lines.learner: 세미나 끝나고 참석자 면담을 할 거예요.
lines.en: We'll meet with attendees after the seminar.
lines.roman: semina kkeunnago chamseokja myeondameul hal kkeoyeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Did you pick a place for the meetings?
lines.en: I thought the small meeting room would be good, so I booked it.

lines.beaver: 혹시 첨부 파일이 안 열린다는 사람은 없어요?
lines.beaver_en: Did anyone say the attachment won't open?
lines.beaver_roman: hoksi cheombu pairi an yeollindaneun sarameun eopseoyo?
lines.learner: 한 분이 그래서 문서를 다시 보냈어요.
lines.en: One person did, so I sent the document again.
lines.roman: han buni geuraeseo munseoreul dasi bonaesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 잘했네요. 업무 소통이 잘되는 것 같아요.
lines.beaver_en: Nice work. Our communication seems to be going well.
lines.beaver_roman: jalhaenneyo. eommu sotongi jaldoeneun geot gatayo.
lines.learner: 네, 이 정도면 준비가 잘됐다 싶어요.
lines.en: Yes, I think we're well prepared now.
lines.roman: ne, i jeongdomyeon junbiga jaldwaetda sipeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Then let's do well at tomorrow's seminar!
lines.learner: 네, 내일 아침에 다시 공지할게요. 수고하세요!
lines.en: Okay, I'll send a reminder notice tomorrow morning. Good work!
lines.roman: ne, naeil achime dasi gongjihalgeyo. sugohaseyo!
